brief:
An Israeli drone strike hit a group of Palestinians in Gaza City, killing one man and wounding dozens of others, Wafa reported. Details about the target's location and the reason the group had assembled were not disclosed.

The strike marked another incident in Gaza's ongoing cycle of Israeli military operations, which have persisted throughout the wider conflict in the territory.
dek: Israeli attack in Gaza City kills one An Israeli drone strike targeting a group of Palestinians in Gaza City has killed one man and wounded dozens of others, Wafa reports.
title: Israeli drone strike kills one in Gaza City
